sequence.description: Protein sequence to embed or to redesign. For `mode=embedding` must contain only canonical amino-acid letters; for `mode=sequence_generation` may include `<mask>` markers (or use `mask_positions`).

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's `sequence` field into the `sequence` input when omitted.

profile_guidance.description: Family-profile guidance compiled from a profile_source upstream. When present, ESM2 runs sequence_generation and masks positions that disagree with conserved consensus evidence.

mode.description: Operation mode. `embedding` returns per-residue and pooled ESM2 representations; `sequence_generation` runs masked-language-model fill-in at positions given by `mask_positions` or `<mask>` markers in the input sequence.

model_name.description: HuggingFace model name for the ESM2 checkpoint. Larger checkpoints (e.g. `facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D`) give better embeddings at higher VRAM cost.

return_attention.description: When true, include per-layer self-attention weights in the output. Increases artifact size substantially; use sparingly for interpretability work.

mask_positions.description: FASTA/sequence 1-indexed positions to mask for `mode=sequence_generation`. Each listed position is replaced with `<mask>` and predicted from the language model.

mask_indices_zero_based.description: Advanced compatibility field: 0-based mask indices into the sequence. Prefer `mask_positions` (1-indexed) unless integrating with code that uses 0-based offsets.
